notes.title: ALL SALES PROFITS GOING TO AUSTRALIA FOR BUSH FIRES
notes.content:
Hey all,

It is not much but what is going on in the world is quite depressing, to be honest, and we feel very bad not helping in any way we can. I (Raph, CEO) personally had the chance to visit Australia last year and discovered a very nice country that does not deserve what is going on right now. We really want to help as much as we can and for that reason, all the money we are going to make from sales on Steam starting now will go either of these donations or funds for Australia bush fires; 
[list]
[*] [url=https://fundraise.redcross.org.au/drr]Australian Red Cross[/url] 
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/donate/1010958179269977/10156907994923595/]Fundraiser for The Trustee for NSW Rural Fire Service & Brigades Donations Fund[/url]
[/list]

Some facts about the fires: 
[list]
[*] Nearly 500 million animals lost
[*] A lot of ancient forests in Australia have been lost to the wildfires
[*] More than 5.9 million hectares (14.7 million acres) have been burned across Australia's six states -- an area larger than the countries of Belgium and Haiti combined. 
[/list]

Again, I know it might not be much but if everyone does help a little bit then we could help a lot.

Thanks again and hopefully this helps.

Here is a video I did last year during my trip to Australia. 

[previewyoutube=GJhtIeWAOxs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demolition puzzler Cefore blasts out of early access today
notes.content:
Blowing stuff up is fun, but blowing stuff up carefully is an art seldom explored by games. Pixelz’s cute physics puzzler Cefore asks its players to blow everything up, but to do it like a professional – you’re trying to recover specific blocks, after all, and you can’t do that if you’ve blown them off the edge of the map. It’s been lurking around in early access for a while, and available direct from the developers since before then. Today’s launch version includes more environments, more levels and a last polish-up on its level sharing system, which is the focus of the video below.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE - CEFORE 1.0 FULL RELEASE
notes.content:
[h1][b]CEFORE PATCH NOTES - 1.0[/b][/h1]
Date: November 9th 2018

[b]General updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the second planet! Desert planet
[*] Added a third planet for the level editor only! Floor is lava
[*] Added new tools and objects to go with the second planet:
[*] Jammer
[*] Large bomb
[*] Drone
[*] Pressure plate
[*] Forcefield wall
[*] Players can now make levels in the second planet also with all the available tools and objects from it
[*] Some object can now be linked to others in the level editor. Once linked they will move with the linked object
[*] Removed Beta splash screen when loading a level
[*] Made the Forcefield still visible a bit when disabled
[*] New music to go with the planet 2
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple bugs with the balloon going crazy on certain objects
[*] Can’t open the level editors tutorial when playing someone else’s level anymore
[*] Fixed being able to place bombs in edit mode of the level editor in some occasion
[*] Fixed additional platforms tops not following properly the main platform
[*] Fixed a physic bug with the floating island
[*] Fixed a bug where you could see the preview of the ball and the bin when cloning it in the sandbox
[*] Multiple objects had some weird behaviour sometimes in the level editor when switching to edit/play mode, fixed
[*] UI attached to objects won’t scale with the objects itself anymore in the level editor
[*] Fixed Baro having a big jetpack boost when using it above mines and some other objects
[*] Fixed multiple bugs related to changing a cube type in the level editor
[*] Music was loading twice when loading from the main menu, fixed
[*] It’s now easier to place floating island on top of another
[*] Fixed game breaking bug when saving a gif on a completed level

[*] Fixed some actions being done even when clicking through UI
[*] Fixed a bug where moving the modular platform in the level editor wouldn’t move the first waypoint with it
[*] Fixed a bug where cloning the floating island would raise the original one
[*] Jammer would keep everything jammed when bulldozed in the editor
[*] Forcefield would always reappear when bulldozed and going back to the edit mode in the level editor 
[*] Drone getting refunded even when has been used is now fixed
[*] Fixed Baronette voice not being mutable 
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Better rotation when placing an object on some occasion
[*] Removed the share buttons on the gif (sharing a gif to twitter/reddit directly isn’t possible anymore) as it was causing multiple issues and it wasn’t really used
[*] Can now rotate the modular platforms console in the level editor
[*] Added a new music in Planet 1 (03)
[/list]

[b]Known issues and bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game crashes in the main menu once in a while due to IMGUR API.
[*] Missing lots of localization in th level editor and planet 2
[/list]

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: About four to six great new Steam games
notes.content:

Still, on the plus side, I high fived Aby Wolf the other night. And now it’s time for Unknown Pleasures! Heavens.

notes.title: CEFORE PATCH NOTES - ALPHA V.0.21 (MAJOR SANDBOX UPDATE)
notes.content:
[h1]CEFORE PATCH NOTES - ALPHA V.0.21[/h1]

https://youtu.be/10flTSJUSLI

[b]General updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the visuals for when highlighting an object with the eraser and with the selecting brush in sandbox
[*]Added a eye-drop tool in the sandbox
[*]Can now shift+drag on a selected object in the sandbox to duplicate it
[*]Added a cube that doesn’t use any physic in the sandbox
[*]Can now press the delete button to delete the current selected sandbox object
[*]Can now spawn a sandbox object with the desired rotation by holding the mouse button (like Baro’s tools)
[*]Added a planet themed sandbox mode
[*]Added 2 new hats for pleasure
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a localization typo in french in the Small bomb tutorial level where it said ‘’Nouveuaz’’ instead of ‘’nouveaux’’
[*]Cannot select Baro’s tools in the sandbox with the select tool anymore
[*]If a mine was selected in the sandbox and then explode, the gizmo now goes away
[*]The ball and the bin get their original scale when replacing them in the sandbox
[*]The ball won’t spin randomly when replacing it anymore
[*]Deleting an objecting in the sandbox now always plays a sound, like it should
[*]Fixed a bug where the game could save 4 times instead of 2 when deleting a sandbox object
[*]Cannot translate / rotate / scale a single plank from the quai in the sandbox anymore (although translating, rotating or scaling the whole quai almost always result in breaking it…)
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn’t place the second part of the grapple or of the support pole
[*]Fixed a bug where you could place a triple ended support pole
[*]Can’t delete an object behind the desired object to delete in the sandbox anymore
[*]Can’t hold the mouse button to delete 2 objects anymore
[*]Removed the gizmo on a selected object in the sandbox if that object got destroyed
[*]Dropdowns basic value in the options are now at their true values
[*]Objects attached to tools won’t fly anymore when the attached tools gets deleted
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn’t complete a level even after collecting every cubes
[*]Game can’t save anymore if the player is dead
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could be dead forever
[*]Baro will play the good animation when undoing while controlling a modular platform
[*]Tools cannot be placed through the HUD anymore
[*]Replacing the ball or the bin in the sandbox now removes the tools that was attached to it
[*]Fixed a bug where Baro wouldn’t get the grapple back on delete when it should
[*]Fixed a bug with the grapple’s physic
[*]Before you could press ‘B’ multiple times before the bomb explosion repeating Baro’s animation, now fixed
[*]Fixed a bug where Baro would keep his remote when holding the flag
[*]The game doesn’t save anymore when pressing trash all if there is nothing to trash
[*]A lot of code optimization
[*]If pausing while in a cutscene, audio sops
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]If Vsync is off the game should now clamp the framerate to 300 fps maximum to avoid overheating good GPUs.
[*]The game now saves before and after translating / scaling / rotating in the sandbox so you can undo these changes
[*]Added new analytics for sandbox and levels
[*]Changed large bomb UI in panel tools (was displaying a wrong color and shape)
[/list]

[b]Known issues and bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*]Controllers plugged in makes everything spin for users
[*]Cubes on the edge of warp zone's reach can't get attached but still get the line renderer
[*]Hot air balloon on metal wall doesn't work at all
[*]Put a hot air balloon on a quai that is not fractured, then make it fracture, you will see that the hot air balloon is not deleted so it just stand in the air and it is still attached to the rigidbody so it can still make the rubbles go up.
[*]Grapples can be placed through stuff, but not walls. merci (same with the balloon's rope)
when selling the warp zone sometimes an attached cube loses its collider
[*]You can access and get out of the modular platform controller from the pause menu
[*]Some UI appear on top of other UI elements (confirmation canvas on top of options menu, Baro's fuel on top of loading screens...)
[*]Can't place tools on top of +1 or -1 UI
[*]Beacon can be place on a modular platform's track and then the modular platform can go through the beacon
[*]At the end of the tutorial cutscene, the jetpack is activated
[*]Placing a beacon on a mine while moving on it result in a mine that will never explode
[*]If you undo at the moment a mine explodes, it won't stop it from exploding sometimes
[*]Beacon button flashes when pressing "W"
[*]Landing from the jetpack at the moment you open a crate causes Baro to open it with the remote instead of the crowbar
[*]Placing the beacon when the player is already near a cube to collect can make the collecting slider appear already full
[*]Collecting a cube when a support pole is attached to it makes the support pole fly
[*]The camera can have a hard time to lerp to the player sometime
[*]Trash all still have issues, sometimes doesn't give tools back when it should
[*]Scaling and rotating a quai in the sandbox just breaks it everytime
[*]Placing tools on sandbox objects than scaling them always result in weird behaviour\
[*]Grapples can get delete for being empty hooked but won't get deleted for being empty based
[*]Place 2+ grapples on the sandbox ball, replace the ball then undo = ball flying around everywhere
[*]Undoing while collecting doesn't make the cube reappear
[/list]

notes.title: Cefore Dev Blog #20 : Sandbox patch soon!
notes.content:
[b]Steam Early Access[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28670588/d0cbc895074172db4e272397073956015e94701a.jpg[/img]

First things first, we finally put the game on Early Access on Steam on April 6th. It was a hard decision to take but we felt we wanted to let players play it on their favorite platform and at the same time, it is a huge opportunity for us to measure and improve on the content, quality and features of the game.

https://youtu.be/f9vR282OAZo

So what do you get when playing Cefore in Early Access? Quite simply a great experience for the price...haha! Seriously though, the game is currently priced at 9,99$. There are 19 available puzzle levels at the moment in the build. Couple of customization items you can unlock and the famous sandbox mode for endless hours of gameplay. Within that same sandbox, we worked really hard on implementing a seamless GIF sharing system that lets you save on your desktop funny moments as GIF and share them on Reddit or Twitter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28670588/6e8e038eedc6e32d9c49f3bdde321fb0bd1847c0.jpg[/img]

[b]Our first PAX EAST![/b]

Yes, yes that is right. The team paid itself a trip to Boston to go and promote CEFORE to PAX EAST 2018! Let’s just say that our first day was a pain for many reasons but the 4 others were simply amazing! Lots and lots of people came by our booth and played the game and it was so much fun. PAX was amazing not only for Cefore but just to see and talk to other devs. We tried to take as much photos and videos during the event but it was harder than expected. You can still check out some snaps here:

[url=https://photos.google.com/share/AF1QipNplDA9mipTR5ZT4NKrUzKkGTQGzWghw6D5DNWxM0S9TTZyO9TE_YXwww7l3vodhw?key=MUNTNjBqNGtqQ2pnV1RfOFVNSGNGWGp1ZjhUbXhn]PAX EAST ALBUM PIXELZ GAMES[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28670588/0bf4ae2b5d8cb5c2efccb122a7afa1fa2e966922.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28670588/eca5abaab8e07ff5dd0d675c8b1f131327a20cd0.jpg[/img]

We also made a little video recap of our trip there with some sick beats! Check it out:

https://youtu.be/aws9oAxPyEs

We really hope we can go to more of these events to talk with you guys and promote the game to as many people as possible! Let’s hope for PAX West in Seattle!

[b]Sandbox mode and next patch![/b]

You heard it first. April 18th or 19th we will launch our first post-release update. It will include a revamp of the Sandbox mode. We polished it a lot since the release and we feel it now is very user friendly to use and it feels just so much better. Currently, you can make GIFS from the sandbox mode and share them with friends on Reddit and Twitter or wherever you want. Also, the latest GIF made by any player is displayed in the main menu on the giant screen. We feel that this is a great way to encourage people to make funny stuff in the sandbox and make the players talk to each other and create a community.

https://youtu.be/10flTSJUSLI

Remember you can always come and talk to us on our Discord channel as we are active on it every single day. Follow us on Twitter and on Youtube as we will start to upload vlogs on a monthly basis.

[url=https://discord.gg/hghx9pr]Discord[/url], our [url=http://www.twitter.com/pixelz_games]Twitter[/url] or even our [url=https://www.playcefore.com/]newsletter[/url] on our website!

Thanks for reading once again, cheers!

notes.title: Explosive physics puzzler Cefore gets a second wind
notes.content:
Cool dudes don’t look at explosions, but thankfully with a mustache and eyebrows like that, the waddling protagonist of explosive puzzle game Cefore doesn’t have to worry about that, so he can fully observe the fruits of his labor.

Despite looking like a lovely hybrid of Besiege and Wii demolition-puzzler Boom Blox, attempts to fund development of Cefore via Kickstarter fell through. Thankfully, Pixelz Games were noticed by publisher Crytivo, and the first early access build of the game rolled out onto Steam today… Kinda.

(more…)
